studio_bridge_twin.why: The Option-3 runner (`.claude/skills/drama-studio/option3_runner.py`) puts `<skill root>/studio_bridge.py` in its scoped command, and with CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT / DRAMA_STUDIO_SKILL_ROOT unset the skill root is the drama-studio folder itself. The bridge is the U5 shared studio bridge whose canonical home is onboarding skill 75's `shared-bridge/`; studio_bridge.py imports its sibling studio_claim.py, so both must be present. A 999 install must receive the actual bridge bytes, never a bare reference.
